text_block_list.text: A few days ago, Ikuno Dictus had invited me to climb a certain mountain. Backpack packed with essentials on my shoulders, I stood before the mountain.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Here it is.
Commonly known as the "Mountain of Trial"â

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
As long as your lower body is properly conditioned,
you can climb this mountain with ease...!

It was a mountain notorious for its treacherous terrain.
I had made every preparation possible to ensure
she could climb it safely.
choice_data_list: Let's be extra careful as we climb!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "Yes. Let's see the results of our training together up to this point!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The road splits into two paths ahead.
There is 'Iwao Slope', steep but short,
and 'Hoso Slope', gentle but long.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I believe the latter, the gentler and longer "Hosozaka" slope, would be preferable today. What do you think?
choice_data_list: If you wanted to test your strength, I thought you'd choose Iwasaka.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It certainly sounds fitting as a test of strength,
though it requires more muscle power than anything else.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "On the other hand, the gentle slope is mild, but it requires more stamina. If you're walking with Trainer, this route should keep you from breaking your pace."
choice_data_list: You were even thinking about us...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Let's work hard and have fun,
and both work up a good sweat together.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's turn right here right away...
(Drip...)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: It's rain... isn't it?

They say mountain weather is fickle, and sure enough,
it started raining. Still, the western sky looks bright,
so it'll probably pass soon.
choice_data_list: I brought rain gear, so let's ride it out with this!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you very much.
Thanks to you, I didn't get soaked.

I roll up the wet rain gear for the two of us.
Did this show enough gratitude for what they did earlier?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, Trainer,
please put your rain gear in here.
It's a waterproof bag for storing wet items.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Now then... Trainer,
it's about time for our rest stop.
choice_data_list: Alright! I'll get the tarp out now!
Alright! I'll get the tarp out now, okay?

text_block_list.text:
Fasten it to a tree with rope,
and make it a temporary resting spot.
Now's the time to put my research to good use...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Leave the fastening to me, then.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I learned the bowline knot beforehand.
It's a type of knot with high holding strength,
which they say comes in handy for setups like this.

I take my hat off to Ikuno Dictus's meticulous preparation.
I had made sure to provide support as well, but she continued to stay one step ahead...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Phew... We've successfully reached the summit.
Thank you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Thank goodness, you seem to be okay.
choice_data_list: Thanks to you, we arrived earlier than planned!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's too early to celebrate just yet.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Look at this view.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
This is what I wanted to see.
Together... with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...The Mountain of Trials.
True to its nickname, this mountain is backbreaking."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why... the view from the summit, after conquering that steep mountain path together, is—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Truly, a magnificent view.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That is why I wanted to see it.
Together with you, Trainer, as we aim for the heights.
choice_data_list: You prepared this meticulously just for that...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ? Doing this much should be a given, shouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I was the one who invited them, after all...
I merely did what was necessary for success. Nothing more.
choice_data_list: Thanks to you, I got to see a wonderful view.
I got to see such a wonderful view thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I was the one who invited them, after all...
I merely did what was necessary for success. Nothing more.
choice_data_list: Thanks to you, I got to see a wonderful view.
I got to see such a wonderful view thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
Fufu, I'm glad I could be of help.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes.
Trainer, would you care for some coffee?
I hear coffee tastes exceptional from the mountaintop.

As she said that, a steaming cup of coffee was already
in her hands. Impressed as always by her efficiency,
I accepted the cup.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...It is nothing worth boasting about.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To plan, to execute, and to achieve results.
—At that point, without needing to assert anything,
I am already satisfied.

Ikuno Dictus gave the faintest of smiles.
It was a moment where, behind her cool expression,
I could feel something burning with intense passion.
